note: One task instance, one artifact. The five shipped files are the ns-bwa-001 worker artifact e8ed2a53eaf0453c... (gate 1.5.0, 46/46 checks on the full artifact, exact-byte --accepted on the worker and re-accepted in jobs ns-bwa-baseline-001 and ns-bwa-diag-001); the package's code/ carries the construction script, the reference implementation, the runner-workdir materializer and the gate, baseline/ the runner-contract baseline. The holdout ships as an asset like the other splits; it is not copied into any runner workdir and was never evaluated. The register publishes one revised-in-place current vintage with no historical vintages, and the evaluation contract declares retrospective research over the pinned snapshot under an isolated-rows access posture, never a point-in-time reconstruction. Recorded finding carried in measurements.json, RELEASE_NOTES.md and VERIFICATION.md: the stock runner baseline (eval AUC 0.5086) trails the shipped site-persistence reference (0.6124) with paired intervals excluding zero - no demonstrated headroom under this protocol; no figure may be quoted without that comparison beside it.
